news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar announced that full 16-week induction-period results from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis were published in The Lancet, giving peer-reviewed detail on efficacy, safety, pharmacodynamics and biomarker findings that underpin the ongoing Phase 3 ZENITH AD program. The publication reinforces the scientific case for rezpeg ahead of its pivotal trials without introducing new clinical data.

news.headline: JPMorgan Reinstates Coverage on Nektar with Neutral Rating, $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan resumed coverage of Nektar with a Neutral/Hold rating and a $65 price target, implying downside from the then-current share price even as the Street's broader consensus stayed bullish on rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Slides as Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 4% in the Q2 earnings reaction as investors weighed Nektar's continued heavy cash burn (Q2 net loss of $40.6M on $10.1M revenue) against progress launching the global Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported $1.02 billion in cash and investments as of June 30, 2026 (up from $245.8M at year-end 2025) and guided year-end cash to $815-840 million, extending its runway into Q3 2028; management reaffirmed a Q4 2026 alopecia areata off-treatment data readout, a Q1 2027 atopic dermatitis off-treatment readout, and said a third ZENITH AD trial (ZENITH AD-3) would begin dosing by end of September 2026.

news.headline: Pretrial Conference Held in Nektar v. Eli Lilly Ahead of September 8 Jury Trial
news.source: U.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. docket (3:23-cv-03943) / Law360
news.summary: A pretrial conference was held before Judge James Donato ahead of the scheduled September 8, 2026 jury trial in Nektar's breach-of-contract suit against Eli Lilly over alleged mishandling of rezpeg trial data; Lilly's motion for summary judgment had previously been denied in March 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials (targeting roughly 1,530 patients total) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with initial topline data expected mid-2028 and a BLA targeted for 2029.

catalysts.label: Jury trial opens: Nektar v. Eli Lilly
catalysts.detail: Breach-of-contract jury trial in the Northern District of California over Lilly's handling/reporting of rezpeg's earlier eczema and psoriasis trial data; a pretrial conference was held August 6, 2026 and Lilly's summary judgment motion was denied in March 2026. Outcome could affect prior collaboration economics and reputational overhang, though it is not expected to affect current rezpeg IP/development rights.

catalysts.label: Start of ZENITH AD-3 trial
catalysts.detail: Third Phase 3 ZENITH AD trial, enrolling biologic/JAK-inhibitor treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients (~510 patients), expected to begin dosing by the end of September per company guidance on the Q2 2026 call.

catalysts.label: Two oral presentations at EADV Congress
catalysts.detail: Nektar will present Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD maintenance-dosing durability data (Dr. Thomas Bieber) and 52-week REZOLVE-AA severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata data (Dr. David Rosmain) in back-to-back sessions at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology Congress in Vienna (Hall N).

catalysts.label: 24-week off-treatment data (alopecia areata)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance for presentation of 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b study, assessing durability of rezpeg's effect after stopping dosing.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to begin a single registrational Phase 3 trial in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, designed following FDA End-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance for 52-week off-treatment durability data from the REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b study in atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline readouts from the Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis registrational program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin.

pulse: Nektar continues executing its post-turnaround plan: it dosed the first patients in the global Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in July, published full REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b induction data in The Lancet in late August, and plans a third ZENITH AD trial by end of September, all backed by roughly $1 billion in cash (guided to $815-840M by year-end) giving runway into Q3 2028 past the first Phase 3 readouts. The most immediate overhang is the Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial set to open September 8, 2026 after a pretrial conference and the denial of Lilly's summary judgment motion; a win, loss, or settlement is a binary event investors are watching alongside two EADV data presentations on October 1 and further REZOLVE-AA/AD durability data due in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. Wall Street sentiment is mixed: Canaccord's Buy/$153 target reflects bullishness on rezpeg's atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata opportunity, but JPMorgan's reinstated Neutral/$65 rating and an August post-earnings stock slide reflect lingering concern over heavy ongoing cash burn ahead of pivotal 2028-2029 data and BLA milestones.
